# P36.59 — Watch pages and item pages (K7 WX-04a)

Manifest row 402. Branch `r11/P36.59-watch-pages-and-item-pages`, stacked on `r11/P36.58-task-export-v2` (the operator retargets to `main`). `live_verification=false` — no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips.

## What landed

The `sig/watch/2` decision calendar renders as a traversable T1, zero-JS route family:

| route | content |
|---|---|
| `/watch/` + `/watch/page/<n>/` | upcoming decisions in the declared 90-day window, sorted by date, ≤50/page (K9 §6.1); kind + place counts; the coverage summary |
| `/watch/place/<path>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`) | the place AND its registry children on K4 display paths (`usa/tx/…`), WITH the coverage statement — every dossier place, empty or not (SIG-WATCH-004) |
| `/watch/kind/<kind>/`, `/watch/vendor/<id>/`, `/watch/technology/<id>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`) | the three one-dimension facets (GX-03 reviewed-vocab term ids) |
| `/watch/item/<handle>/` | one alert date with `date_kind` + `date_certainty`, the timeline, body, subjects, `what_you_can_do`, evidence claims + J3 §5.3 upstream lanes, the shared provenance panel, related research tasks |
| `/watch/history/<path>/` | the place's past items (the declared `recently_decided` window) |
| `/watch/feeds/` | the subscription directory — the emitted `.ics`/`.xml` only, plus the no-email-list rule; the per-place v2 feed set is WX-04b's |

Honesty carried through: `upper_bound` dates render "latest possible date", never "deadline" (SIG-WATCH-002); empty places name the actual cause class — `not_connected` / `not_monitored` / `none_found` — beside the coverage statement (SIG-WATCH-010); the dossier 'Next decisions' block matches items on `jurisdiction_key` so its count equals the place page's (SIG-WATCH-009).

Owns SIG-WATCH-001/002/003/004/010; cites SIG-UI-039/040, SIG-ENG-042. The scoped recommender stays out (WX-05); the feeds/OPML/nginx-type work stays out (WX-04b).
